label: India
notes: Academic results carry real weight. Render education.grade for every entry, and include isced-2 and isced-3 rows - 10th and 12th standard - with the board named, not only the degree.
Current and expected compensation use basis: ctc. CTC bundles allowances and is not a salary; converting it to one misstates the figure.

The declaration block - 'I hereby declare that the information above is true to the best of my knowledge' with place and date - is conventional and its absence is noticed. render.declaration drives it.
Father's or husband's name is a distinct field in traditional and public-sector formats. It lives in person.name.related_names, not appended to the name.
Languages are listed with a read/write/speak split rather than a single level.
Private-sector technology employers increasingly follow the region-neutral convention. Ask before emitting photo, date of birth or marital status; expected is not the same as required.
